title: Gold Bar XL Blue Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Pack in Blue Raspberry captures the sharp, tangy flavour of this fruity fan-favourite in a simple all-in-one pod and refill combo. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Together, they provide extended vaping performance with a clean, consistent flavour profile and a smooth, satisfying draw. These Refill Kits are designed exclusively for use with the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, a simple-to-use vape kit with a long-lasting 1200mAh battery for all-day use. The mesh coil built into each pod delivers excellent flavour and vapour output for discreet mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Once both the pod and refill reservoir are empty, the entire unit can be swapped out for a fresh refill in any flavour from the exceptional Gold Bar XL range.
